why_it_passes: a setting on the person's own machine, every value spelled out; the check reads zm's record of that machine

input.title: Let your Mac take tasks from the team
input.brief:
1. Open Terminal on your Mac, bea-mac (zm is already installed there).
2. Run: zm config set remote_tasks true
3. Run: zm daemon restart
4. Run: zm status and confirm it says remote tasks: on.
input.check: zm ask machines human:bea --json | jq -e '.[] | select(.machine=="bea-mac") | .remote_tasks == true' >/dev/null
